messages:
kevin-ops: Heads up — EMEA Dedicated pools are trending under our 24h capacity buffer. I just pinged the vendor to request a partial top-off and see if they can consolidate a couple RMAs into one shipment to FRA.

maria-sourcing: Numbers? which models and how many units are we talking about?

kevin-ops: Need +30 H200s in FRA region by next Tue to keep latency SLOs for several paid customers. Vendor allocation shows 18 immediately available; 12 are marked as RMA pending. PO #78921. RMA refs: `RMA-4312`, `RMA-4313`.

jordan-vendorliaison: Vendor responded — they can prioritize 15 H200s for FRA via air if we accept a consolidated AWB. They also offered 8 swapped units (lower bin) as a cheaper alternative at -$400/unit. They ask us to confirm consolidated AWB to avoid per-piece customs holds.

anna-logistics: Consolidated AWB is doable, but freight cost delta is ~€1.2k for air consolidation. Routing via AMS hub avoids an expected 48h customs ping in FRA and saves time overall.

kevin-ops: @maria-sourcing can you approve the price delta + expedited freight so we can go ahead? If not, fallback is routing ~15 from US pool which adds ~30ms p95 and longer sit-up times.

maria-sourcing: Approve expedited freight and the swap for up to 15 units, contingent on vendor providing perf verification that swapped units meet our 95th percentile perf gates and warranty parity. Please get that in writing.

jordan-vendorliaison: Vendor confirms swapped units are labeled 'refurb-L3', come with 12mo warranty, and they provide perf snapshots showing pass at our 95th percentile thresholds. They'll issue consolidated AWB `AWB:125-998234` and an invoice addendum reflecting -$400/unit on the 8 swapped units.

devops-bot: note: If FRA receives +15 units, autoscaler will rebalance and estimated reclaim time is ~45m. If only +15 vs the needed +30, queue backlog will still grow — we should treat this as partial mitigation.

anna-logistics: Important: two DOA replacements in RMA queue must have serial verification before export. If we include them under the consolidated AWB customs may request the serial manifest. I can supply CSV of serials and photos.

kevin-ops: Plan: 1) Route 15 expedited from vendor to FRA (consolidated AWB). 2) Prepare 15 emergency air from US pool if vendor slips. @jordan-vendorliaison please get AWB + manifest asap. I'll schedule a canary join once nodes are live.

jordan-vendorliaison: On it — will send AWB, manifest and updated invoice by COB. tagging @supply-bot to create task items.

supply-bot: Created ticket INF-4520: 'FRA top-off + consolidated AWB' assigned to anna-logistics and kevin-ops.

kevin-ops: Thanks all — once AWB + manifest are in I'll update the runbook and schedule the canary. :thumbsup:
